d: Our Approach We Match You — We Don't Just Schedule You Most studios put you with whoever has an open slot on Tuesday. We start with a conversation, be
b: our approach we match you — we don't just schedule you most studios put you with whoever has an open slot on tuesday. we start with a conversation, because the right teacher for a 9-year-old learning her first chords is not the right teacher for a working guitarist chasing bebop. 01 step one the conversation call us, or stop by the shop. we'll spend about fifteen minutes on what you want out of playing — the songs you're chasing, whether you've played before, how much time you realistically have in a week, and what's worked or gone badly for you in the past. no cost, no commitment. if we're not the right fit for what you're after, we'll say so and point you somewhere better. 02 step two your instructor match based on that conversation we recommend one or two of our five instructors — matched on genre, teaching style, and temperament, not just calendar availability. freddy for jazz and theory. houston for electric and ukulele. ryan for acoustic, classical and flamenco. cade for bass and upright. scott for all-round guitar. if the match isn't clicking after a few weeks, tell us. switching instructors is normal, free, and nobody's feelings get hurt. 03 step three your first lesson thirty or sixty minutes, one-on-one. your instructor works out where you actually are — not where a curriculum says you should be — and you leave with a concrete plan and something specific to practise.
